title: Krea 2 LoRA training speed
footnote: Seconds per step: the time from step 40 to step 100, read from each trainer's own progress output as it happens (past every trainer's warm-up and compile). Peak memory: the GPU's use during the run, less what was in use before. *Fizgig also trains its 8 small input, output and time layers (264), and pads captions to 512 tokens (its attention trims the padding). All three use PyTorch's attention: Fizgig's Krea 2 model loads with attn_mode "torch", flash-attn installed or not. Every run is reproducible from github.com/Nynxz/lora-trainer-bench.
